Method of Attack: Backdoor, Binary blobs handcrafted with a hex editor
Discoverer: Andres Freund, a software engineer at Microsoft
Attack Vector: The method by which the code was introduced into xz (and liblzma) involved a few binary files added to the xz repository, and a compromised build process.
Indicators of Compromise: The sshd process, responsible for accepting remote secure shell connections, was using an excessive amount of CPU even on failed connection attempts, with a 500 ms delay impacting connections.
